# watchpoint_monitor_group (Data Source)

Looks up a single monitor group by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_monitor_group" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the monitor group to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Hex color used for the group's UI accent.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Free-form group description.
- `icon` (String) Icon shown for the group in the UI.
- `id` (String) Monitor group ID.
- `sort_order` (Number) Display sort order.
